The '''dwelling of [[Lott Kemp]]''', a [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]], was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dodz]]. It was decimated by the [[Destroyer (droid)|Destroyer]], a [[Battle droid/Legends|killer droid]] owned by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Kugg]], when Kemp refused to pay the corrupt governor's heavy taxes, though the crystal merchant escaped with his life<ref name="The Destroyer" /> and fled off-world.<ref name="The Droids Re-Animated, Part 1">{{SW|url=news/the-droids-re-animated-part-1|series=The Droids Re-Animated|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref>
